resources.string: Bounded technical logs: version, generic platform, codes and code lines. No tokens, callsigns, QSOs, frequencies, audio, location, ports, device or installation identifiers. The HTTPS receiver may know your IP and connection metadata. Sending is off by default; approval sends the latest 16 entries in the foreground. Secret stays in memory; restarting disables sending. No radio connection or TX. Existing detailed USB reports remain private and are never automatically sent.
